title: Final departure handover and readiness
outcome: Approved operator staff can complete a governed final departure handover only when the departure manifest is operationally ready, record final exceptions and handover evidence, and preserve an auditable immutable departure-closeout trail without mutating authoritative source-module state.
actor: Approved operator staff responsible for final departure closeout.
modules: Booking owns final handover state, optimistic versions and append-only handover audit evidence.
VS-27 readiness remains authoritative for operational blocker calculation; VS-28 consumes equivalent source projections without mutating Payments, Documents, Visa or Accommodation state.
Catalogue remains authoritative for departure identity and schedule.
Web adds a final handover workspace using the established NoorPath operator shell and visual language.
routes: Final handover -> review blockers and completion evidence
Final handover -> complete governed departure handover
acceptance: Operator-isolated final handover projection is reachable from departure operations.
Handover cannot be completed while authoritative readiness blockers remain.
Final completion requires an explicit handover note and remains auditable.
Completed handover is read-only except for a separately governed correction workflow.
No payment, document, visa, accommodation or booking commercial source state is mutated.
Desktop and mobile rendered flows pass accessibility, target-size and overflow checks.
Product Owner approval is required for the exact certified SHA before merge; production deployment remains separately approved.
policyDecisionsRequired: No automatic override of readiness blockers.
Any exceptional departure approval must be explicit, reasoned and auditable through a separately governed workflow rather than this completion endpoint.
exclusions: Airline ticketing or supplier check-in integration
Document, visa or accommodation source-state mutation
